title: A complete scan read by the agent from a scanner

raw.description: What the scanner sent, at most 4096 bytes: as text when it is valid UTF-8 without control characters, otherwise base64 (raw_encoding).

symbology.description: Optional: only when the scanner reports it (e.g. AIM ID ]d2).

scanner_id.description: Stable scanner name from the agent config (printable ASCII).
